  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 1 else if ((n % 2) == 0) then (1 + (2 * f((n / 2)))) else (2 * f((n / 2)))))

  effects pure
  example (f(0) == 1)
  example (f(1) == 2)
